headline: Sapna Uttam Tulsiani resigns as independent director of Oriental Aromatics
hook: Board seat vacant at Oriental Aromatics

modes.bear: Loss of independent oversight can occasionally raise questions on board stability if frequent departures occur.
modes.bull: Board shuffles are normal corporate housekeeping and do not affect the company's manufacturing or sales performance.
modes.simple: A company director has stepped down. This is standard paperwork and does not change how the business runs or affect your investment.

summary: Oriental Aromatics Limited has announced the resignation of Mrs Sapna Uttam Tulsiani from her position as a Non-Executive Independent Director, effective November 24, 2026. The company communicated this change to the stock exchange through a routine corporate filing. Such board departures are standard governance updates that do not directly alter the financial operations of the company. For retail investors holding the stock, routine changes in independent board positions carry minimal immediate impact on share value.
whats_next: Appointment of a replacement independent director
why_it_matters: Routine board change with no direct impact on your holdings.
